answer: Use a slow-arrival admission gate: each new identity must send first actions as sparse, randomized traffic and wait out a delay window before they count. The per-identity cost is one full delay window of idle time plus a minimum shaped-traffic volume, so mass sign-ups cannot cheaply arrive together. A legitimate agent crosses that ridge at its own pace, but a flat summit of simultaneous arrivals gets capped, and every fake identity still pays the same sable wait.
